publications.title: (EN | PT) The use of Arduino-based automation in controlling the proliferation of microorganisms.
publications.subtitle: Q2 Quartile Journal – Revista Científica Multidisciplinar Núcleo do Conhecimento
publications.description: Highly important research for the COVID-19 scenario.The project aimed to test the effectiveness of automation prototypes in minimizing the proliferation of microorganisms between individuals by automating manual processes, such as faucets and door handles.I pitched this project to large microbiology companies in search of sponsorship. Studied electrical circuits and brought the prototypes to life. Founded a team and managed talents. Learned from scratch how to construct a scientific article. Mastered microbiology and data science to provide a research foundation. Practiced and honed skills in persuasion, leadership, and product vision.At 18, right after high school, I achieved a scientific publication in a journal with an impact surpassing 50% of all published research in the field of computer engineering – comparable to journals ranked within the Q2 quartile. I discovered my passion for research and developed intense perseverance in achieving my goals.PT ––––––––––Pesquisa extremamente importante para o cenário da pandemia da COVID-19.Um projeto com o objetivo de testar a eficácia de protótipos de automação na minimização do contato indireto entre indivíduos, automatizando processos manuais, como torneiras e maçanetas.Apresentei este projeto a grandes empresas de microbiologia em busca de patrocínio. Estudei circuitos elétricos e dei vida aos protótipos. Fundei uma equipe e gerenciei talentos. Aprendi do zero como construir um artigo científico. Dominei microbiologia e ciência de dados para fornecer uma base de pesquisa. Pratiquei e aprimorei habilidades de persuasão, liderança e visão de produto.Aos 18 anos, logo após o ensino médio, consegui publicar a pesquisa científica num periódico de Qualis B1 – com um impacto que ultrapassou 50% de toda pesquisa já publicada no campo da engenharia de computação. Descobri minha paixão por pesquisa científica e desenvolvi uma intensa perseverança em alcançar meus objetivos.

projects.title: SLiM
projects.description: Built in 36 hours at ShellHacksSmart LLM Router + Incremental Model trainerLarge Language Models are powerful, but expensive and slow to call repeatedly. Teams often ask the same kinds of questions (emails, bug fixes, summaries), wasting tokens and compute. We wanted to build a system that learns from repetition, automatically training a small language model to handle common queries while routing complex tasks back to a larger LLM.This inspired SLiM — a framework that reduces cost and latency by auto-promoting common queries into a small specialized model.
